Due to hygiene reasons this product is excluded from our 30 Day Money Back Guarantee (your statutory rights are not affected).

Deluxe disposable mask with an ergonomic 3D design to fit most face shapes and an improved face seal for added comfort. Includes a modern design valve for lower breathing resistance. Offers an assigned protection factor (APF) of up to 10 times the workplace exposure limit (WEL) for fine non-toxic dusts, fibres, fumes and mists. Perfect for fit testing.
